name: Do I need to replace all my pipes if I have rusty water?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to replace all my pipes if I have rusty water?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. Whether you need to replace all your pipes depends on the root cause of the rusty water. If the issue is localized, such as a failing hot water heater or a single corroded pipe section, only that component may need replacement. However, if your home has widespread old galvanized pipes, which are prone to internal corrosion and rust, a full repiping might be the most effective and long-term solution to prevent recurring issues and ensure water quality throughout your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: You may not need to replace all pipes. It depends on whether the rust is localized or if widespread old galvanized pipes are corroded.
